entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Jalaj Kumar Tripathi,Kalp Dev Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Suneel Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 are present.
In compliance of order dated 22.02.2024 the trial court has transmitted photocopy of the statement of the applicant Ram Niwas and Sitaram and Smt. Maya Devi, opposite party nos. 2 and 3.

The compromise deed dated 05.04.2021 and photocopy of the order sheet have also been transmitted to this court whereby the parties have arrived at a compromise and the compromise has been verified by the applicants and opposite party nos. 2 and 3.
Co-accused Jasraj is said to have died but he is not made a party in the case.
The compromise between four applicants and opposite party nos. 2 and 3 is accepted.
Photocopy of the compromise deed dated 05.04.2021 and photocopy of the order dated 20.01.2024 verifying the compromise deed shall form part of the order.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed in terms of compromise.
